boxes.name: Command line
interface: main(argv: [str]) → int  // reads the command line and runs one command
cmd_add(url: str)  // pocket add: saves one page
cmd_read(id: PageId)  // pocket read: prints a saved page
cmd_find(words: str)  // pocket find: lists the pages that match

boxes.name: Pages
interface: save(url: str) → PageId  // fetches, cleans and stores one page
read(id: PageId) → Page?  // one saved page
Page = { id: PageId, url: str, title: str, text: str }  // one saved page

boxes.name: Cleaning
boxes.line: keeps the article, drops the rest
interface: clean(html: str) → str  // the readable text of a page

boxes.name: Search
boxes.line: finds saved pages by their words
interface: find(words: str) → [Page]  // the pages that hold every word, best first

boxes.name: Store
interface: put(page: Page) → PageId  // stores one page
get(id: PageId) → Page?  // one page, or nothing

boxes.name: Fetching
interface: fetch(url: str) → str  // the HTML of one page, with a time limit

boxes.name: Desktop notices
boxes.line: says when a page is saved
interface: notify(title: str)  // shows a desktop notice

links.label: commands
links.says: Every command calls Pages or Search.

links.label: pages
links.says: Saving a page downloads it through Fetching.

sketch: id: PageId = pages.save(url)  # fetches, cleans and stores the page
html: str = fetch.fetch(url)  # downloads the page, with a time limit
text: str = clean.clean(html)  # keeps the article, drops the rest
notify.notify(title_of(html))  # says the page is saved
